changelog: All-new Fluid interface — an Apple-inspired dark design with fluid motion, depth and vibrancy (switch back to Classic anytime in Settings → Appearance)
Orbit 1.4 now reliably creates and edits real files in your workspace — no more code pasted in chat
New: the agent can use the terminal (mkdir, rm, npm install, builds, git) with safety guardrails
Files appear in the Explorer the instant they're created, by the agent or anything else
Pasted-code fallback: even if the model narrates, CodeOne saves the files for you (never overwriting existing ones)
Live streaming while the offline model works — no more frozen-looking replies
Fully offline / air-gapped — your code never leaves your machine
